channel.title: Ente Community Discord digest
channel.description: AI-generated daily recap of activity in the Ente Community Discord server

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 03, 2026 - 39 messages in 7 channels
item.description:
Ente Community saw moderate activity, led by discussion in #photos around album sharing, translations, and imports. #space and #ensu also had product questions and troubleshooting, while other channels were quieter.

#photos

With 15 messages from 9 participants, members discussed hiding Memories from the main feed, blank video thumbnails, and making shared album links more recognizable without compromising encryption. A Crowdin translation-count issue was clarified, with related work tracked in GitHub PR #11861; CLI imports for Photos were also queried.

#space

Nine messages from 4 participants covered claiming the Space role, keeping Space separate from Photos, and its encryption model; Anand confirmed Spaces use a separate key. A browser upload failure was traced to a company proxy, and the team noted that messaging and private replies already exist, with group-context comments under consideration.

#ensu

Seven messages from 2 participants focused on an iPhone/Safari web download error and differences between mobile and browser models. The app was suggested as a workaround, and the platform-specific model defaults were explained.

#off-topic

Four participants discussed passkey-only login, encryption constraints, and whether passkey PRF could help, including a link to an explanation of passkey PRF.

#introduce-yourself

Two newcomers briefly introduced themselves.

#clicks

One attachment was shared.

#memes

A reminder was posted to share appropriate memes.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 02, 2026 - 68 messages in 6 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw moderate activity, led by practical Ente Photos support discussions. Other conversations covered passkeys, Space profile aliases, account recovery, and a few casual greetings.

#photos

With 48 messages from 14 participants, the channel focused on update checks and troubleshooting, including Windows ARM compatibility, face and pet tagging, merging detected people, missing video thumbnails, and controlling Memories in the main feed. Members also shared troubleshooting guidance, including reporting issues with logs via support@ente.com, and linked a GIF.

#off-topic

Eight messages from five participants discussed passkeys and two-factor authentication, comparing implementations across Google, Microsoft, Ente, and different operating systems. The conversation also touched on services advertising themselves as ad-free while potentially introducing ads later.

#space

Six messages from two participants clarified that “login to existing account” refers to an Ente Photos account and explored using multiple aliases and profiles for family, friends, coworkers, and hobbies.

#auth

A reply addressed account recovery, explaining that the recovery key can bypass TOTP but not a forgotten password.

#introduce-yourself

Four participants exchanged greetings, including a new member welcoming Ente.

#memes

One participant shared a brief reaction to a meme.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Aug 01, 2026 - 107 messages in 6 channels
item.description:
Ente Community saw its busiest activity in #photos and #space, with discussions spanning product questions, bug reports, browser compatibility, and feature feedback. Smaller channels covered account recovery, app architecture, product suggestions, and casual sharing.

#photos

With 55 messages from 20 participants, discussion covered the two open security advisories and pending CVEs, AppImage/Flatpak/Snap packaging, caching shared albums, and requests for improved photo-picker search and album access. Members also reported Linux Flatpak drag-and-drop upload failures, a GrapheneOS crash, and asked about encryption; the encryption architecture was shared, and the photo-picker request was added to the roadmap without an ETA.

#space

Thirty-five messages from 12 participants focused on Ente Space browser behavior, including Windows Brave/Chrome sharing issues and a Vanadium login spinner on GrapheneOS. A desktop browser fix to copy the link was reported as working, while several members shared enthusiasm about signing up and discussed account login and aliases.

#off-topic

Twelve messages covered Featurebase as a possible privacy-friendly feedback platform, including its Discord/GitHub integrations and AI help agent. The rest was casual discussion about social-network business models and an Ente plush, including a cat GIF.

#auth

A user raised a question about whether Ente Auth recovery could work with the recovery key alone after simulating the recovery process.

#ensu

Discussion asked why Ensu mobile apps use native frameworks rather than Flutter with Rust FFI.

#memes

One meme link was shared.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 31, 2026 - 13 messages in 4 channels
item.description:
Ente Community saw 13 messages across four active channels, with most discussion focused on recent Photos improvements and product questions. Off-topic conversation also shared a couple of links.

#photos

Six messages from five participants praised the latest update, especially smoother photo swiping. Members discussed Samsung gallery edits, uploads larger than 10 GB, and stream generation; Ente clarified that originals are currently preserved and invited feedback on streaming.

#off-topic

Five messages from four participants joked about GitHub’s “pancake” button and hamburger menus, with links to a related post and an article about a potential U.S. robot vacuum ban.

#introduce-yourself

One new member welcomed the Ente team, praised its vision, and said they had questions and suggestions.

#auth

One message noted that Auth is not updated very frequently at present, though that may change.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 30, 2026 - 27 messages in 5 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw light activity across five channels, with the most discussion focused on Ente Photos OCR and Auth installation options. Members also shared introductions, a video, and a few casual updates.

#photos

There were 10 messages from 6 participants. Discussion covered OCR issues with Polish and other non-English characters, setting Ente Photos as the default gallery app on NothingOS, and whether a liquid glass UI is planned. A member also reported progress on an immich-go adapter and asked about Ente’s exported JSON schema, while another praised the latest update’s smoothness.

#auth

There were 10 messages from 3 participants about installing Ente Auth via Flathub versus RPM packages. Replies compared update timing, sandboxing, permissions, and recommended using whichever package format fits the user’s usual setup.

#introduce-yourself

Three newcomers introduced themselves, including a graphic and UI/UX designer interested in contributing to FOSS, alongside brief greetings and a mention of Ente’s water-themed name.

#off-topic

Three messages included a useful video mention, a question for SDR++ users, and a link to a video about an alleged iPhone 18 Pro Max leak: YouTube.

#memes

One meme attachment was shared.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 29, 2026 - 42 messages in 7 channels
item.description:
Activity was moderate, led by a busy discussion in #photos. Members focused on translations, file limits, platform availability, and text-detection feedback, alongside a few introductions and casual shares.

#photos

With 28 messages from seven participants, this was the busiest channel. Members discussed Italian and French translations, celebrated Italian reaching full coverage for mobile clients, and answered a question about the 10 GB file-size limit with a link to the Ente Photos FAQ. Other posts asked about FreeBSD availability and reported issues with text detection for special Polish characters.

#off-topic

Five messages covered a shared video, a T-Mobile “Liquid Glass” clip, and discussion of AI-generated content and custom system prompts.

#introduce-yourself

Three new members introduced themselves, highlighting their enthusiasm for Ente and possible contributions in translation, design, and other project support; one also mentioned exploring the GitHub repository.

#clicks

Two posts shared a photo of a cat in snowy Sarajevo and an attachment.

#memes

Two image posts were shared.

#locker

One follow-up message said an issue appeared account-related and occurred on both Android and iOS.

#ensu

One message clarified that a user was exploring a question rather than reporting a problem, mentioning a ThinkPad P50 running Fedora.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 28, 2026 - 43 messages in 8 channels
item.description:
Activity was concentrated in #photos, with discussions spanning app behavior, development, metadata, ML recognition, translations, and backup troubleshooting. Other channels saw lighter introductions, community chatter, and shared media.

#photos

With 26 messages from 8 participants, the channel covered iOS deletion permissions, pull request labeling, sidecar and Google metadata formats, the web editor, animal and wildlife recognition, and translating ML suggestions into Italian and French. item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 27, 2026 - 23 messages in 4 channels
item.description:
The Ente Community saw light activity across four channels, with discussion focused mainly on border-device privacy, photo metadata/import behavior, and community contributions. Off-topic was the busiest channel, followed by photos.

#off-topic

Twelve messages from six participants discussed border searches, device resets, access requests, and related legal considerations in the US, Canada, and elsewhere. Members also discussed a recent rise in community pull requests, with one participant noting 43 PRs, and shared Kill the Cookie Banner.

#photos

Eight messages from four participants covered delays in new photos appearing in galleries, Immich’s importer behavior, sidecar files, EXIF date parsing, and compatibility with Google’s formats. The channel also briefly discussed iOS deletion permissions and the use of tags such as [mobile][photos] in pull requests.

#ensu

Two participants discussed improving model selection for systems with under or over 16 GB of RAM and troubleshooting a related setup. A follow-up offered to investigate after receiving more details.

#memes

One attachment was shared.

item.title: Ente Community Discord Jul 26, 2026 - 12 messages in 3 channels
item.description:
Activity was modest, with 12 messages across three channels. Discussion centered on Ente Photos features and workflows, alongside a brief off-topic privacy conversation and two new-user introductions.

#photos

Five messages from four participants covered Ente Photos collages, how cloud uploads affect the home gallery, bulk photo rotation, and syncing Ente with locally hosted Immich. One participant also mentioned opening a PR for straightening, horizon leveling, or image rotation.

#off-topic

#introduce-yourself

Two newcomers introduced themselves: one is exploring privacy-focused AI, while another is getting started with Ente Photos from Southern Europe.
